messages:
clare: Heads-up — client wants a short deliverable for their vendor review: show RBAC rollback evidence, KMS export provenance, and a concise IR decision log. 10 min slot.

 diego: Proposal: create three artifacts: rbacsafe-redact.json, kms-trace.csv (hashed ids + HMAC), ir-decision-notes.md. sign manifest with our evidence key.

 sophia: I'll extract KMS slice and compute counts by key/op and include the HMAC header file. Fields: export_id_hashed,key_id,op,ts,caller_type,caller_hashed. Sign with /keys/evidence-2026.pem.

 kms-bot: Notice: key-rotation scheduled at 8300001280; rotation-job=rot-8300.

 auditor: Request: include an explicit SIEM query that proves the exporter was a service account and a short grep from keystore logs showing agent=exporter/2.0.

 clare: Diego — please run RBAC diff read-only and redact emails. paste query here for reviewers.

 diego: Read-only SQL I will run:
 ```
 SELECT actor_id, change_type, resource, old_role, new_role, ts
 FROM rbac_audit
 WHERE tenant='client-q' AND ts BETWEEN 1716000000 AND 1716003600
 ORDER BY ts ASC;
 ```
 Expect ~21 rows. I'll produce `rbac-delta.patch.gz` and compute SHA256. Redaction: `redwood-redact --mask-emails --mask-ids`.

 sophia: SIEM example: `index=kms_ops AND tenant:client-q AND event:export | where actor_type=="service_account" | table request_id, actor, _time` — we'll map masked request_id -> export_id_hashed in kms-trace.csv.

 ir-lead: For IR decision log include: detection, containment (readonly gating), key rotation (minor), split-escrow promote, postmortem link PM-558. Keep operator ids masked.

 clare: Add retention note: we exported 48h slice; intermediate copies purged with `redwood-delete-log --bundle-id <id>`; attach deletion audit entry.

 auditor: Please include verification command for manifest: `evidencectl verify --bundle <bundle> --pubkey /keys/evidence-verify.pub.pem` — auditors will run this live.

 diego: Building bundle now and signing:
 ```bash
 evidencectl bundle create --id client-q-2026-07-20 --inputs /tmp/clientq-evidence --signer sophia --out /tmp/clientq-bundle.tar.gz
 ```
 I'll upload and post SHA here.

 kms-bot: Backup snapshot completed at 8300001295 snapshot=snap-8300.

 sophia: Uploaded signed manifest and `signed-headers.hmac` to s3://enterprise-evidence/client-q/. bundle sha256: e2f3d4c5b6a7d8e9f0a1b2c3d4e5f67890123456789abcdef0123456789abcd.

 diego: Redaction check passed: `redwood-redact --verify rbacsafe.json` -> no PII detected. attaching `redaction-report.txt`.

 clare: Great. Action items: diego (rbac diff + annotated reasons + SHA), sophia (kms slice + signed headers), ir-lead (decision log + PM link). We'll rehearse 15m before the review. :thumbsup:
